description: Look up a Colombian legal entity / ESAL in RUES by NIT: razón social, cámara de comercio, estado de matrícula, CIIU activity codes, registration and renewal dates. Legal entities only; natural-person fields are never returned. Source: Confecámaras RUES via datos.gov.co (CC BY-SA 4.0); not an official RUES/DIAN service. Free: 20 calls per client per UTC day, shared by the Colombia tools (co_company_status, co_company_lookup). When the free quota is used up the tool returns an error naming the paid HTTP endpoint https://co.redtapeapi.com/v1/company/{nit} ($0.005 USDC per successful call over x402 on Base, no account or API key).

nit.description: Colombian NIT, digits with optional check digit

title: Colombia RUES company lookup by NIT
